entities.name: Cuban Missile Crisis
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: A 13-day confrontation (October 16–28, 1962) between the US and USSR over Soviet nuclear missiles in Cuba, bringing the world closest to nuclear war. Resolved through diplomacy and secret negotiations, it led to the Nuclear Test Ban Treaty and direct communication hotline.
